Fieldwork

Ground school for the real world.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems with the community. A mentor checks the work as you go. Consider it logbook practice.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Waiting on a cadet intake? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship for school and university students, built around a live Earth5R project near home. The work gets verified, which is more than most gap years can say. earth5r.org/fieldwork
